name: Keemun Black Tea Collection - 250g Ceramic Gift Set
marketing_tip: A curated selection of premium Keemun black teas in artisanal ceramic packaging.
body: This 250g set features a variety of Keemun black teas, including Jin Zhen, Xiang Luo, and Mao Feng. The ceramic canisters ensure freshness and add a touch of elegance to the gift.
